global_identity.color_palette: Before panel: dark plum #2B1226 fading to bottle black #0E0E10. After panel: hot fuchsia #E6177F glowing to bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 with deep magenta #B0105E shading. global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Playful, feminine, confident and aspirational; gloomy and muted on the left, soft glow, sparkles and hearts on the right.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pill labels at the top of each panel, curved white arrow from before to after, casual handwritten marker notes with tiny doodled arrows and hearts, white four-point sparkles, a round black seal with small stars, a soft pink flower behind the bottle, a bottom row of three thin-line white icons with small labels.
global_identity.text_typography: As in the reference: headline in a heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / ExtraBold look), ALL UPPERCASE, tight leading, left-aligned, with a subtle soft drop shadow; subheadline in a clean regular sans-serif (Poppins Regular look), sentence case, white; side notes in a casual handwritten marker script, sentence case; pill labels in bold uppercase sans-serif; seal text in bold uppercase sans-serif; icon labels in small regular sans-serif.

creative_objective: Recreate the winning before/after ad exactly, adapted to this bottle and palette, so the viewer who compares herself with others feels the emotional change from feeling flat to feeling secure, with the bottle as the bridge and the pay-on-delivery seal lowering the fear of buying.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The two cartoon women and the dark-to-bright contrast. 2) The two-color uppercase headline at top right. 3) The bottle with the pink flower at bottom right. 4) Handwritten notes, seal and icon row.
art_direction.composition_style: Vertical split: left panel about 37% of the width (dark), right panel about 63% (bright fuchsia). Each panel has its own woman seen from behind in three-quarter view. Text and product live in the right third of the image.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline block top right, subheadline right below it, a column of three handwritten notes between the right woman and the bottle, bottle bottom right, round seal left of the bottle at the bottom, icon row along the bottom right edge. Left notes stacked down the left edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Left: dim cool lighting, low saturation. Right: bright warm pink glow, soft rim light on the character, sparkles. The bottle sharp with a soft shadow and gentle glossy highlights on the cap.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

A thick curved white arrow crosses from the left panel into the right panel at mid-height. Right panel (x 37–100%): fuchsia glowing background with white sparkles and outline hearts, pill label 'DESPUÉS' at the top near the split, the same woman in the same dress seen from behind, confident, eyes closed and smiling, with a fuller, curvier silhouette. Top right: two-part uppercase headline, below it a two-line white subheadline. Middle right: a column of three handwritten notes each with a small outline heart. Bottom right: the product bottle standing in front of a large soft pink flower. Bottom center-right: round black seal with small stars. Bottom right edge: row of three thin-line icons with short labels.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 before/after split-screen ad in glossy 3D animated cartoon style (Pixar-like render), recreating exactly the attached reference composition. LEFT PANEL (left 37% of the width): dark plum-to-black gradient background, muted and gloomy; at the top center a translucent grey-plum rounded pill label; a small white hand-drawn scribble doodle at the top left; a 3D cartoon young Latina woman with long straight dark brown hair, wearing a short pink satin slip mini dress, seen from behind in three-quarter view, looking back over her shoulder with a worried, sad expression, slim flat hips and thin legs, standing slightly hunched; three short white handwritten marker notes stacked along the left edge, the first one with a small curved hand-drawn arrow pointing at her. A thick curved white arrow crosses from the left panel into the right panel at mid-height. RIGHT PANEL (remaining 63%): bright hot fuchsia background glowing to bubblegum pink, with white four-point sparkles and small outline hearts; a pale pink rounded pill label at the top near the split; the SAME 3D cartoon woman with the same hair and the same pink satin slip dress, seen from behind in three-quarter view, confident, eyes closed with a soft happy smile, with a fuller, rounder, curvier hip and leg silhouette, tasteful and non-explicit, filling the center of the image from top to bottom. TOP RIGHT: a bold two-part uppercase headline block, left-aligned, first part in white, second part in bottle black, with a two-line white subheadline under it. MIDDLE RIGHT, between the woman and the bottle: a vertical column of three short handwritten notes in dark plum, each with a small outline heart. BOTTOM RIGHT: the product — use the attached product photo as the only source of truth for the product and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth; black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. The bottle stands upright, rendered photorealistically and sharp with a soft shadow, in front of a large soft pink flower with glowing petals. BOTTOM, left of the bottle: a round black seal with a thin fuchsia rim, three small stars on top and bold white uppercase text. BOTTOM RIGHT EDGE: a row of three thin-line white icons (a leaf, a capsule, a heart), each with a tiny white label below. Only the text listed in the exact visible text section; no other text, no extra modules.
